groupExperiment.packageSource: Current package-candidates.json explicit anchor + member sets, not merged families or display core cards. Nominations postdate cutoff: exploratory only, not leakage-free historical discovery.
groupExperiment.selection: Training composition only: 150 supported singles, frequency beam 200 at sizes 2–5, up to 100 per size at 3–5. Minimum 100 matches, 20 events, 20 players. Not exhaustive. Eligible level counts include evaluated candidates only.
groupExperiment.comparisons: Cards + triples; cards + all selected 3–5-card groups; cards + nominated package full/partial presence. Each jointly fitted with context and cards, penalty 100. No pairs in these models.

method.target: Match point share: win 1, draw 0.5, loss 0. One observation per match.
method.split: First 70% distinct UTC dates train, later dates test. Retrospective holdout already used by earlier analytics research; not an untouched prospective validation.
method.baseline: Prior-day Elo frozen at cutoff; context adds signed champion within format and champion matchup within format. Format is recorded event format, not set/ban era.
method.cardAverage: Training-only per-card match-point rate with 20 neutral prior appearances, averaged by copies; prediction 0.5 + own average - opponent average. Both sides contribute to training counts.
method.adjusted: Sparse ridge residual regression with context and card quantities, plus separately fitted group presence or package completion states. No intercept ensures side-swap symmetry.
method.selection: See groupExperiment for training-only recurring group discovery and separately labeled post-cutoff package nominations. No holdout-outcome tuning.
method.uncertainty: 400 paired event-cluster bootstrap samples; positive error reduction favors candidate. Does not account for cross-event player dependence.
limitations: No historical catalog or ban-era reconstruction
Exact unseen-deck subset does not isolate near-duplicate families
No causal interpretation of card coefficients
No prospective validation; existing package nominations postdate training cutoff
